name: openbb_treasury_rates
description:
Daily US Treasury constant-maturity yields, one row per day with a column per maturity (month_1 to year_30), through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.government.treasury_rates); rates are decimals (0.0417 = 4.17%).
Returns: {provider, data_points, truncated, start_date, end_date, rates: [{date, month_1, month_3, ..., year_10, year_30}]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): start_date (default one year ago); end_date (default today); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 260; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (federal_reserve, fmp; default federal_reserve).
One date across maturities: openbb_yield_curve; Fed funds: openbb_fixedincome_effr. Keys: federal_reserve needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"start_date": "2026-09-01"}

start_date.description: Start date; default one year ago (YYYY-MM-DD)

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
